questions.q: Where do you actually search Fabric's audit log?
options: The Microsoft Purview portal, searching the unified audit log
A dedicated 'Audit' screen inside the Fabric workspace itself
The Power BI Desktop application's File menu
The OneLake catalog
questions.explain: Fabric auditing is a setting turned on in the admin portal, but the actual search happens in the Microsoft Purview portal's unified audit log — the same log every other Microsoft 365 workload writes to.

questions.q: Which of these is a real Fabric/Power BI audit log operation name?
options: UpdateDatasetParameters
RefreshLakehouseInstant
AuditLogAutoClean
FabricSecurityOverride
questions.explain: UpdateDatasetParameters is a real, documented operation name generated when a Power BI semantic model's parameters are changed. The other three are not real operation names.

questions.q: What changed about Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Datamart audit events starting around July 2025?
options: Their per-item operation names were standardized into shared generic names like CreateArtifact and ShareArtifact
Auditing for those item types was discontinued entirely
They moved from Microsoft Purview into a brand-new Fabric-only audit screen
They began requiring a separate Azure subscription to log at all
questions.explain: Microsoft standardized redundant per-item operations (like CreateWarehouse and CreateDatamart) into shared generic operation names — CreateArtifact, UpdateArtifact, ShareArtifact, and so on — used consistently across item types.

questions.q: What's the core difference between the Fabric Monitor hub and the audit log?
options: The Monitor hub is an operational view of recent job runs; the audit log is the longer-term security and compliance record of who did what
They are two names for the exact same screen in Fabric
The Monitor hub only shows data for Power BI reports, while the audit log covers every other item type
The audit log only retains data for 24 hours, while the Monitor hub retains it for a year
questions.explain: The Monitor hub shows current and recent job runs (refreshes, pipeline runs) for operational troubleshooting. The audit log is the who-did-what compliance record, searchable over a much longer window.

questions.q: By default, which role groups already carry the Audit Logs role needed to search the audit log?
options: Compliance Management and Organization Management
Everyone with a Fabric Free license
Only the tenant's billing administrator
Workspace Viewers and Workspace Members
questions.explain: By default, the Compliance Management and Organization Management role groups in Exchange Online already have the Audit Logs role assigned, which is why most Global Admins and Compliance Admins can search without extra role assignment.
